placeName.zh-CN: 中国浙江省台州市临海市

details.direction: From Xingshanmen Square via the Jiangnan Great Wall and Ziyang Old Street into the forested mountains of Kuocang, Youxi and Yongfeng towns, returning on a closed loop to Xingshanmen. The 105K runs through the core Kuocang forests; the 50K and 25K use middle and shorter sections.
details.distanceMethod: 2026 official regulations and course page give 105.0 km; this page does not average conflicting figures.
details.attribution: 柴古唐斯括苍越野赛 2026：临海古城、括苍山与 105 公里的山野环线 / Chaigutangsi Kuocang Trail 2026: Linhai’s old town, the Kuocang mountains and a 105 km loop. Race facts from the 2026 official notices and host-city government pages; editorial schematic only, no official track bundled.
